result.topic_en: New formulas for lemniscatic functions: series for the lemniscatic integral, addition theorems for the lemniscatic sine, and a method for expanding fφ in a power series via complex multiplication by (1+i), with computed coefficients and a log series.
result.transcription:
III, 406

Einige neue Formeln die Lemniscatischen Functionen betr.

Es sei $\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{(1-x^4)}} = \varphi$, oder $\varphi = x + \frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{5}x^5 + \frac{1.3}{2.4}\cdot\frac{1}{9}x^9 + \frac{1.3.5}{2.4.6}x^{13}\ldots$
Man hat dann $\varphi\varphi = xx + \frac{3}{5}\cdot\frac{1}{3}x^6 + \frac{3.7}{5.9}\cdot\frac{1.3}{5}x^{10} + \frac{3.7.11}{5.9.13}\cdot\frac{1}{7}x^{14}\ldots$

Es sei $x=f\varphi$, $y=f\psi$, so hat man

$f(\varphi+\psi) = z = \frac{x\sqrt{(1-y^4)}+y\sqrt{(1-x^4)}}{1+xxyy} = \frac{xx-yy}{x\sqrt{(1-y^4)}-y\sqrt{(1-x^4)}}$

$\sqrt{\frac{1-zz}{1+zz}} = \frac{-2xy+\sqrt{(1-x^4)(1-y^4)}}{1+xx+yy-xxyy} = \frac{-1+xx+yy+xxyy}{2xy+\sqrt{(1-x^4)(1-y^4)}}$

$\sqrt{\frac{1-z^4}{2z}} = \frac{x(1+y^4)\sqrt{(1-x^4)}-y(1+x^4)\sqrt{(1-y^4)}}{(1+xxyy)(xx-yy)}$ $\sqrt{(1-zz)} = \frac{\sqrt{(1-x^2)}\sqrt{(1-y^2)}-xy\sqrt{(1+x^2)}\sqrt{(1+y^2)}}{1+xxyy}$

$\sqrt{(1-z^4)} = \frac{(1-xxyy)\sqrt{(1-x^4)(1-y^4)}-2xy(xx+yy)}{(1+xxyy)^2}$ $\sqrt{(1+zz)} = \frac{\sqrt{(1+xx)}\sqrt{(1+yy)}+xy\sqrt{(1-xx)}\sqrt{(1-yy)}}{1+xxyy}$

Die einfachste Manier $f\varphi$ in eine Reihe nach Potenzen von
$\varphi$ zu entwickeln scheint folgende zu seyn.

Man hat $f(1+i)\varphi = \frac{(1+i)f\varphi}{\sqrt{(1-f\varphi^4)}}$

Setzt man also $(f\varphi)^{-2} = \varphi^{-2}(1+\alpha\varphi^4+\beta\varphi^8+\gamma\varphi^{12}\ldots)$
[-so wird-] und folglich $(f(1+i)\varphi)^{-2} = -\frac{1}{2}i\varphi^{-2}(1-4\alpha\varphi^4+16\beta\varphi^8-64\gamma\varphi^{12}\ldots)$

Also $f\varphi^2 = -2i[f(1+i)\varphi]^{-2}+[f\varphi]^{-2} = 5\alpha\varphi^2-15\beta\varphi^6+65\gamma\varphi^{10}-255\delta\varphi^{14}\ldots$

Man hat also
$(1+\alpha t+\beta t^2+\gamma t^3+\delta t^4+\text{etc.})\cdot(5\alpha-15\beta t+65\gamma t^2-255\delta t^3+1025\varepsilon t^4\ldots) = 1$

Hieraus
$5\alpha = 1$
$3\beta = \alpha\alpha$
$13\gamma = 2\alpha\beta$
$51\delta = 14\alpha\gamma - 3\beta\beta$
$205\varepsilon = 50\alpha\delta - 10\beta\gamma$
$819\zeta = 206\alpha\varepsilon - 54\beta\delta + 13\gamma\gamma$
$3277\eta = 818\alpha\zeta - 202\beta\varepsilon + 38\gamma\delta$
$13107\theta = 3278\alpha\eta - 822\beta\zeta + 218\gamma\varepsilon - 51\delta^2$

$\alpha = \frac{1}{5}$
$\beta = \frac{1}{75}$
$\gamma = \frac{2}{4875}$
$\delta = \frac{1}{82875}$
$\varepsilon = \frac{2}{6215625}$

[-\frac{176}{25\,45\ldots}-][?]
$\zeta = \frac{2}{242409375}$
$\eta = \frac{4}{19527421875}$
$\theta = \frac{223}{44815433203125}$

$\log P = \log\varphi - \frac{1}{12}\alpha\varphi^4 - \frac{1}{56}\beta\varphi^8 - \frac{1}{132}\gamma\varphi^{12} - \frac{1}{240}\delta\varphi^{16} - \frac{1}{380}\varepsilon\varphi^{20} - \frac{1}{552}\zeta\varphi^{24}$
$= \log\varphi - \frac{1}{60}\varphi^4 - \frac{1}{4200}\varphi^8 - \frac{1}{321750}\varphi^{12} - \frac{1}{19890000}\varphi^{16} - \frac{1}{1180968750}\varphi^{20}\ldots$
$-\frac{22}{1.756255921875}\varphi^{24}\ldots$
